# A raw element's tag and attribute names have to be known when html writes
# the element: in a page, once the page is folded, and in the script, where
# the element is created. Each is refused with the program's position rather
# than written as `<element>` or with its attributes dropped.

! sngl generate --platform=html tag.sngl
stderr 'tag.sngl:8:\d+: "tag" must be a string literal'

! sngl generate --platform=html attrs.sngl
stderr 'attrs.sngl:13:\d+: "attrs" must be a map literal'

! sngl generate --platform=html slot.sngl
stderr 'slot.sngl:11:\d+: "attrs" must be a map literal, or a choice between map literals'

! sngl generate --platform=html untagged.sngl
stderr 'untagged.sngl:10:\d+: a raw element needs its "tag" prop to name a tag'

! sngl generate --platform=html empty.sngl
stderr 'empty.sngl:10:\d+: a raw element needs its "tag" prop to name a tag'

# A choice between map literals is written under the condition that chose it.
sngl generate --platform=html --out out choice.sngl
grep 'setAttribute\("data-w", "1"\)' out/index.html
grep 'setAttribute\("data-n", "1"\)' out/index.html

-- tag.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"
import time "sngl:time"

output { none { html } }

ui.window(title="t") {
    html.element(tag=string(time.now())) {}
}
-- attrs.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"
import time "sngl:time"

output { none { html } }

func stamp() map[string, string] {
    return {"t"=string(time.now())}
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    html.div {}
    html.div(attrs=stamp()) {}
}
-- slot.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"

output { none { html } }

var shown = true
var extra map[string, string] = {"a"="b"}

ui.window(title="t") {
    if shown {
        html.div(attrs=extra) {}
    }
}
-- untagged.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"

output { none { html } }

var shown = true

ui.window(title="t") {
    if shown {
        html.element(attrs={"data-a"="1"}) {}
    }
}
-- empty.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"

output { none { html } }

var shown = true

ui.window(title="t") {
    if shown {
        html.element(tag="", attrs={"data-a"="1"}) {}
    }
}
-- choice.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import html "sngl:platform/html"

output { none { html } }

var wide = false

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.button(text="wide", @click { wide = !wide })
    if wide || !wide {
        html.div(attrs=wide ? {"data-w"="1"} : {"data-n"="1"}) {}
    }
}
